findings.location: Proof 5.1, the step that puts the disk-map interior in finite PL general position relative to S
findings.evidence: The proof assumes relative PL approximation and general position, then infers that the disk-map preimage of S is a finite union of circles. Its listed triangulation and Loop-theorem inputs do not state or prove this construction for the arbitrary disk map. Close the gap with a finite relative PL or smooth approximation and general-position theorem preserving the boundary class and collar, or prove that construction. The assigned Gordon–Luecke proof uses only this supplier’s first assertion, so the gap is in its separate incompressibility criterion.
